guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table browser compatibility on mobile without horizontal page overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep semantic table/thead/tbody/th; wrap in a scroll container with tabindex=0, role=region and an accessible name; keep cells legible rather than shrinking columns.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: every table is in a .table-wrap with tabindex/role/aria-label (compat table uses aria-labelledby its caption); header cells use scope; multi-column tables get a 34rem min-width so they scroll inside the region instead of breaking words. Exception: no sticky headers or stacked layout, because the tables are short (at most 7 rows).

guidanceConsulted.query: embedding third-party iframe demo lazy loading sandbox in documentation page
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Minimise what third-party embeds receive; control referrer and capabilities of cross-origin content.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: showcase iframe carries sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" and referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" per the gendn iframe posture.

guidanceConsulted.query: embedding third-party iframe demo lazy loading sandbox in documentation page
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Defer offscreen heavy embeds so they do not compete with initial render.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: iframe uses loading="lazy" and sits below the code examples.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status banner note landmark baseline
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic HTML first; give non-landmark notes an accessible name; ensure visible focus for keyboard-scrollable regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: baseline banner role=note with aria-label; :focus-visible outline on .table-wrap using a CSS variable.
